channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Balboa Park revealed: 8 hidden histories of San Diego’s ‘crown jewel’
item.description: Balboa Park is San Diego’s crown jewel, celebrated for its gardens, museums, and stunning Spanish-style architecture.

item.title: Opinion: Autonomous vehicles are the future — San Diego must embrace them
item.description: The future of transportation is not buses, trolleys, bicycles or traditional taxis; it is autonomous vehicles, and they are arriving rapidly.

item.title: Man, woman found dead on street in Grant Hill, with 3 children in nearby car
item.description: Police said the man and woman, both in their late 20s to early 30s, were apparently victims of "homicidal violence."

item.title: Local rabbi disinvited from speaking at King breakfast over Israel connection
item.description: The rabbi of a local synagogue was disinvited from delivering a message at the All People’s Breakfast, drawing criticism from San Diego’s Jewish community.

item.title: Sitcom based in OB makes its way around the indie film circuit
item.description: Ocean Beach got its own show this fall, and now it’s starting to garner some serious attention in festivals from Los Angeles to New York.

item.title: Two San Diego ferries named to National Register of Historic places
item.description: Silvergate (built in 1940) and Cabrillo (1964) are owned and operated by Flagship Cruises & Events and are still in regular use.

item.title: Warm start to week in San Diego County, then cooling trend with chance of rain
item.description: Warmer-than-normal weather will stick around in San Diego County into the early part of the week as high pressure remains over the region, according to the National Weather Service. item.title: Four arrested in 2004 cold case murder outside Chula Vista pizzeria
item.description: Four men accused in the stabbing death of a man outside a Chula Vista restaurant more than 20 years ago have been arrested, it was announced Monday.

item.title: Coastal rail service to close between San Diego and Oceanside again this weekend
item.description: Heads up for weekend travelers - coastal rail service between San Diego and Oceanside will be suspended again Saturday and Sunday for routine maintenance and infrastructure projects.

item.title: Suspected arsonist caught hiding in bushes after string of fires in Bonita
item.description: An arson investigation was underway Monday after at least one-quarter acre of vegetation burned beneath a highway in Bonita.
